name: norm-s-pdf-filer
title: Norm's PDF Filer
description: Rename PDFs using Raycast AI and file them to a WebDAV server
author: NormC

ai.instructions: You are a document filing assistant. When given the text content of a PDF, generate a clean, descriptive filename (without the .pdf extension). Follow the user's naming format preference if provided. The filename should be filesystem-safe: no slashes, colons, or special characters. Return ONLY the filename, nothing else.

commands.name: rename-and-file-pdf
commands.title: Rename and File PDF
commands.subtitle: Norm's PDF Filer
commands.description: Rename the selected Finder PDF using AI and upload it via WebDAV

commands.name: pick-and-file-pdf
commands.title: Pick and File PDF
commands.subtitle: Norm's PDF Filer
commands.description: Choose a PDF file, rename it using AI, and upload it via WebDAV

preferences.name: webdavUrl
preferences.title: WebDAV URL
preferences.description: The base URL of your WebDAV server (e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/user)

preferences.name: webdavDestFolder
preferences.title: Destination Folder
preferences.description: The destination folder path on the WebDAV server (e.g. /Documents/Filed)

preferences.name: namingInstructions
preferences.title: Filename Format Instructions
preferences.description: Tell the AI how to format filenames (e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DD - Document Title - Author' or 'Category_Title_Date')
